jobs.title: Drift Wood #24 · gone
jobs.prompt: a four-panel comic strip laid out as a two-by-two grid on a half page, thin black panel borders (4 panels). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Cast, drawn the same in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 18, gaunt boy drawn a head too tall, oversized thrift-store wool overcoat to the knee worn indoors, faded black tee, dark jeans, sneakers, a bristol pad clutched flat to his chest, chin up. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: The envelope is gone. The strip does not say where. Panel 1: a teenage boy drawing at a bedroom table, a jar of pens on a clear tabletop where something used to be, black and white (in this panel: WOOD). No dialogue in this panel. Panel 2: close-up of a wastebasket under a drawing table full of crumpled paper drafts. No dialogue in this panel. Panel 3: a teenage boy pinning a new comic strip to a crowded corkboard above his drawing table that holds a newspaper page, a crab flyer and a yearbook photo (in this panel: WOOD). Wood says "There. A body of work.". Panel 4: a wide quiet view of a teenage boy's bedroom at night from the door, the boy at his drawing table with his back turned, a crowded corkboard, rain in the window, no words (in this panel: WOOD). No dialogue in this panel. Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized gull, two strokes. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, build, hair and clothes exactly. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
